title: TIG-CDO Replication Package: Transaction Intent Graph for Composite Defense Orchestration in Microservices Payment Systems
description:
Replication package for “Transaction Intent Graph: Semantic Cross-Layer Defense Orchestration for Microservices Payment Systems” (Rangari, Mishra, Senapati; manuscript under review, 2026). Contains the TIG-CDO component implementations (STC, CLCS, BIM, PSRG, PADO, FDCE), the evaluation harness and follow-up analyses, the calibration scripts that ground model parameters in public data together with their checked-in outputs, the Kubernetes payment-microservices testbed manifests and service sources, the CSDA scenario definitions, figure-generation code, the companion-survey baselines and cross-dataset validation scripts, and a bundled copy of the Apache-2.0 Nigerian Banking Card Transactions dataset (3.0M records).

Headline results: in a 69-scenario evaluation under four defense configurations, TIG-CDO realizes 99.9% SLA compliance against 49.0% undefended (88.1% vs. 80.9% when recomputed against real heavy-tailed latency distributions); the FDCE rule engine detects 30/30 scenarios with 2.43 s mean latency and a 0.023% false-positive rate on real card-authorization data. REPRODUCTION.md maps every table and figure to its command and states which values are reproduced exactly, approximately (Monte Carlo), or consumed as configured input.

See README.md for the directory map. Bulk third-party datasets are not re-hosted; they are listed below as isDerivedFrom identifiers and documented in data/manifests/.
